stories.title: Hundreds spot fireball as asteroid piece streaks over Western New York
stories.summary: A mysterious flash over Western New York has an explanation. NASA says a piece of an asteroid about a foot wide created the fireball.

stories.title: State lawmakers prepare for upcoming Legislature session in Albany
stories.summary: Affordability and energy are still key points amid potential federal funding cut impacts.

stories.title: Sump pump malfunction forces remote learning day for Buffalo school
stories.summary: District officials on Sunday a faulty sump pump and resulting odor prompted the temporary move to online instruction while repairs are underway.

stories.title: Tonawanda woman dies after exiting moving vehicle in Amherst, police say
stories.summary: Police continue to investigate the circumstances surrounding a fatal incident on Smith Road in Amherst that left a 38-year-old Tonawanda woman dead.

stories.title: 5 displaced after basement fire damages Buffalo home
stories.summary: Three adults and two children were displaced after a fire broke out in the basement of a Buffalo home near Military Road.

stories.title: Buffalo firefighters battle 3-alarm warehouse blaze in Kaisertown neighborhood
stories.summary: The fire started just before midnight, and was escalated to a 3-alarm response.

stories.title: Two injured, charged after shooting on Potomac Avenue
stories.summary: Two men were injured after being shot on Potomac Avenue in Buffalo Saturday night. The men were hospitalized and have been charged for having illegal guns, BPD says.

stories.title: Officers catch anglers with 11 fish, issue 9 tickets in Newfane
stories.summary: Two anglers in Niagara County thought they could explain away the fish in their vehicle, but officers had been watching them for hours.

stories.title: Chimera officially announces run for Erie County Executive
stories.summary: In what has been considered the worst kept secret in WNY politics, Deputy County Executive Lisa Chimera officially announces bid for Erie County's top job.

stories.title: Harlem Road reopens following crash; Amherst Police seek witnesses
stories.summary: A crash investigation has shut down part of Harlem Road in Amherst. Police are urging drivers to avoid the area.

stories.title: Hundreds gather at UB for event that inspires girls through sports
stories.summary: From flag football to volleyball, girls got the chance to try new activities and learn about careers connected to sports at a special event at UB.

stories.title: Buffalo parents, teachers discuss suspensions and student success
stories.summary: How can schools keep students learning while addressing discipline concerns? That was the focus of a community discussion on Saturday morning.
